questions.dialogue: Welcome to the City Museum. Our guided tours run every hour, starting at 10 AM. The first tour today is fully booked, but there are still spots available for the 11 AM and 12 PM tours. Please meet at the information desk 10 minutes before your tour begins.

questions.question: When does the first tour start?

questions.title: The Impact of Technology on Education
questions.passage: Technology has dramatically transformed the way we learn. In recent years, online education has become increasingly popular, especially after the COVID-19 pandemic. Students can now access quality education from anywhere in the world through online platforms. However, some argue that traditional classroom learning still offers benefits that online learning cannot fully replicate, such as social interaction and hands-on experience.

questions.question: When did online education become more popular?
What is one advantage of traditional classroom learning?
If it ____ tomorrow, we will cancel the outdoor event.
questions.explanation: 真實條件句：if + 現在式，未來用 will。

questions.question: By next year, she ____ here for five years.
questions.explanation: 未來完成式：by + 未來時間，用 will have + p.p.

questions.question: The book ____ on the table is mine.
questions.explanation: 分詞結構：the book lying = which is lying。

questions.question: No sooner ____ arrived than the meeting started.
questions.explanation: 倒裝句：No sooner + had + 主詞 + p.p.
